scripts.dev:web:clean: pnpm --filter web clean && pnpm exec turbo run dev --filter=web
scripts.dev:web:fresh: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter web clean && pnpm exec turbo run dev --filter=web
scripts.clean: pnpm exec turbo run clean && npx rimraf node_modules
scripts.prepare:production: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.release:check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.release:check:mobile: pnpm exec turbo run typecheck lint --filter=customer --filter=provider && pnpm run parity:check
scripts.build:customer:ios: cd apps/customer && eas build --profile production --platform ios
scripts.build:customer:android: cd apps/customer && eas build --profile production --platform android
scripts.build:provider:ios: cd apps/provider && eas build --profile production --platform ios
scripts.build:provider:android: cd apps/provider && eas build --profile production --platform android
scripts.submit:customer:ios: cd apps/customer && eas submit --profile production --platform ios --latest
scripts.submit:customer:android: cd apps/customer && eas submit --profile production --platform android --latest
scripts.submit:customer: pnpm --dir apps/customer exec eas submit --profile production --platform ios --latest && pnpm --dir apps/customer exec eas submit --profile production --platform android --latest
scripts.submit:provider:ios: cd apps/provider && eas submit --profile production --platform ios --latest
scripts.submit:provider:android: cd apps/provider && eas submit --profile production --platform android --latest
scripts.submit:provider: pnpm --dir apps/provider exec eas submit --profile production --platform ios --latest && pnpm --dir apps/provider exec eas submit --profile production --platform android --latest
scripts.submit:all: pnpm run submit:customer && pnpm run submit:provider
scripts.submit:customer:android:internal: pnpm --dir apps/customer exec eas submit --profile internal --platform android --latest
scripts.submit:provider:android:internal: pnpm --dir apps/provider exec eas submit --profile internal --platform android --latest
scripts.submit:android:internal: pnpm run submit:customer:android:internal && pnpm run submit:provider:android:internal
scripts.submit:customer:android:open: pnpm --dir apps/customer exec eas submit --profile openTesting --platform android --latest
scripts.submit:provider:android:open: pnpm --dir apps/provider exec eas submit --profile openTesting --platform android --latest
scripts.submit:android:open: pnpm run submit:customer:android:open && pnpm run submit:provider:android:open
